security_scope: Disposable fixed fixtures and fresh joint keys run with genuine Chou-Orlandi and IKNP OT. Complete key generation and threshold signing use the shared resumable core. No wallet admission, durable shares, production peer authentication, or authorized cloud export flow is implemented.
measurement_scope: Client wall time includes request and response transport. Worker Date.now observations are elapsed markers. CPU billing and actual physical placement require separate platform evidence.
sampling_scope: One warm-up precedes each kernel. The measured samples establish observed latency only; they do not establish a production tail-latency bound.

reproduction.authentication: PROBE_TOKEN is read from the environment for hosted runs. Its value is never included in this artifact.

client_verification.verifier: Node crypto parses the standard key; the fixed case checks independent canonical bytes

a.linear_memory_scope: Current isolate-wide Wasm linear memory. JavaScript buffers and total Worker memory are excluded.
a.reference_result: Both roles generated independent seed contributions. No seed reconstruction occurs in this pipeline.

transport.clock: Worker Date.now; IO can advance this clock. These values are elapsed observations, not CPU billing measurements.

b.linear_memory_scope: Current isolate-wide Wasm linear memory. JavaScript buffers and total Worker memory are excluded.
b.reference_result: Both roles generated independent seed contributions. No seed reconstruction occurs in this pipeline.

report.scope: Complete eighteen-circuit canonical key generation on separate Workers. Each role completes its own private signing material and discards it after this disposable benchmark. No signature is generated.
security_limits: Passive honest execution only. The public-challenge and aggregate-acceptance composition requires independent cryptographic review.
No wallet admission, durable share storage, production peer authentication, or authorized export flow is implemented by this probe.
Classical OT does not provide post-quantum transcript confidentiality. The linear arithmetic has no target-specific constant-time qualification.
Incoming colo does not establish equal physical Worker placement. Elapsed clock observations do not establish CPU charges or total isolate memory.
